description: List native MangroveAI backtest runs for the authenticated user and organization, newest first. Filter by a native MangroveAI strategy_id when known. Results include backtest IDs, linked strategy IDs/names, recorded start/end dates, status and metrics. Missing links or dates remain null; never infer them from asset or creation date. Counts represent runs, not distinct strategies or necessarily completed tests. Use limit and offset to paginate; follow next_offset while has_more is true. Use get_backtest with a returned backtest ID for the full recorded result.

offset.description: Pagination offset in the result units documented by the tool; zero starts the first page.

name: list_backtests
